hyperedges.label: Targets, days off, and pace calculation
Locale-independent text to keep jsPDF safe

nodes.label: src/lib Pure Logic Layer
nodes.rationale: All business logic in plain TypeScript without React, tested next to the code.

nodes.label: Components Are UI Only (props in, callbacks out)
nodes.norm_label: components are ui only (props in, callbacks out)

nodes.label: now: Date Passed as Parameter
nodes.rationale: lib functions never read the clock themselves, which keeps them testable and render pure.

nodes.label: jsPDF + jspdf-autotable
nodes.rationale: Loaded via dynamic import inside export function to keep off server and first load; built-in fonts cannot render Turkish/Arabic.

nodes.label: Phase Workflow (test, lint, tsc, build, then wait for OK)
nodes.norm_label: phase workflow (test, lint, tsc, build, then wait for ok)

nodes.label: Arabic UI and RTL (§13)
nodes.rationale: Requested by user; digits stay 0-9; Noto Sans Arabic via next/font with no runtime Google request.

nodes.label: Automatic Days Off and Missed Days
nodes.norm_label: automatic days off and missed days
nodes.rationale: Chosen by user: no extra input; empty past days up to allowance are days off.

nodes.label: Backup and Restore JSON (§12)
nodes.rationale: Restore always replaces (merging could create overlaps), excludes running session, blocked while working, rolls back on failed write.

nodes.label: Custom Window Event After Writes
nodes.rationale: The storage event only fires in other tabs, so same-tab updates need a custom event.

nodes.label: Monthly CSV and PDF Exports (§7)
nodes.rationale: Per-month export via month picker so last month's report can still be exported.

nodes.label: Formats Spec (§4: DD Mon YYYY, HH:mm, 8h 05m, HH:MM:SS)
nodes.norm_label: formats spec (§4: dd mon yyyy, hh:mm, 8h 05m, hh:mm:ss)

nodes.label: Future Phases 14-19 (Arabic exports, overtime, notes, manual days off, reminders, charts)
nodes.norm_label: future phases 14-19 (arabic exports, overtime, notes, manual days off, reminders, charts)

nodes.label: Hour Targets, Progress and Pace (§10)
nodes.rationale: Defaults 10h/day, 2 days off/month; weekly target always 7x daily.

nodes.label: Hourly Rate and Earnings (§9)
nodes.rationale: Each session keeps its own rate; integer cents; currency codes not symbols so PDF stays safe.

nodes.label: Live Timer (now - startTime, not a counter)
nodes.norm_label: live timer (now - starttime, not a counter)
nodes.rationale: Stays correct across refresh, background tabs and other tabs.

nodes.label: localStorage Keys (work_sessions, active_work_session, pay_settings, work_targets, ui_language)
nodes.norm_label: localstorage keys (work_sessions, active_work_session, pay_settings, work_targets, ui_language)
nodes.rationale: Invalid JSON counts as missing; invalid items skipped so bad data never crashes the app.

nodes.label: Session Validation Rules (no overlap, no future end)
nodes.norm_label: session validation rules (no overlap, no future end)

nodes.label: Pace Analysis (expected, ahead/behind, needed per day, projection)
nodes.norm_label: pace analysis (expected, ahead/behind, needed per day, projection)

nodes.label: SaaS Ideas (out of scope)
nodes.rationale: Requires a backend, which Hard rules forbid; would need KVKK/GDPR compliance.

nodes.label: Start/End Work Behavior (re-read, write session before clearing active)
nodes.norm_label: start/end work behavior (re-read, write session before clearing active)
nodes.rationale: Adding the session before removing active_work_session means a failed write cannot lose a session.

nodes.label: Statistics Rules (§5: sessions count for start day, Mon-Sun week)
nodes.norm_label: statistics rules (§5: sessions count for start day, mon-sun week)

nodes.label: useSyncExternalStore Storage Subscription
nodes.rationale: getSnapshot returns stable raw strings to avoid infinite re-render; server snapshot means not loaded yet.

nodes.label: Vitest with TZ=Europe/Istanbul
nodes.rationale: A non-UTC time zone makes UTC-vs-local bugs fail the tests; set in config because inline env vars fail on Windows npm scripts.

nodes.label: Your Data Stays in Your Browser
nodes.norm_label: your data stays in your browser

nodes.label: Next.js Breaking Changes Notice (read node_modules/next/dist/docs)
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version differs from training data; agents must read the bundled docs and heed deprecations before writing code.

nodes.label: Dependency Allowlist (jspdf, jspdf-autotable, vitest)
nodes.rationale: Only create-next-app deps plus jspdf, jspdf-autotable and vitest; ask before adding date/UI/icon/state libraries.

nodes.label: MESSAGES via useI18n (error codes, not sentences)
nodes.norm_label: messages via usei18n (error codes, not sentences)

nodes.label: Local Date Keys Rule (never toISOString().slice)
nodes.rationale: UTC date puts sessions near midnight on the wrong day; build YYYY-MM-DD from getFullYear/getMonth/getDate.

nodes.label: No any; JSON.parse as unknown with Type Guards
nodes.norm_label: no any; json.parse as unknown with type guards

nodes.label: Hard Rule: No Backend (client-side only)
nodes.rationale: User data never leaves the browser: no API routes, server actions, database, auth or network requests.

nodes.label: No toLocaleString Formatting Rule
nodes.rationale: Output changes with browser language, and Turkish or Arabic text breaks jsPDF's built-in font.

nodes.label: Start/End CSS for RTL Mirroring, Ltr Wrapper
nodes.norm_label: start/end css for rtl mirroring, ltr wrapper

nodes.label: 1-second Tick Only Inside Timer
nodes.rationale: Prevents the rest of the page re-rendering every second.
